lines.zh: 我沿着河底走，几乎不露背。
lines.en: I walk the riverbed, my back barely breaking the surface.

lines.zh: 长吻划开水面，只留一线波纹。
lines.en: My long snout parts the water, leaving one ripple.
Four legs push slowly underwater.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我就滑出去很远。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail carries me far.
I haul out and my belly meets the mud.

lines.zh: 我伏在岸边，只把眼睛露出来。
lines.en: I lie at the bank with only my eyes showing.
I drag my tail across the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像一段浮木。
lines.en: I move slowly, like drifting timber.

lines.zh: 河湾那边有动静，我转过去。
lines.en: Something stirs at the bend; I turn toward it.
I move along the reeds.

lines.zh: 我下水时几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I enter the water almost silently.

lines.zh: 我把身体半沉下去，往前挪。
lines.en: Half-submerged, I shift forward.
The sun warms my back plates.

lines.zh: 我停下来，水面只留下一对眼。
lines.en: I stop, only a pair of eyes above water.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块沉在水里的石头。
lines.en: I round a stone sunk in the water.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流，几乎不用动。
lines.en: I ride the current, barely moving.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一截木桩。
lines.en: I hold still like a stump.
Water slips past my snout.
I haven't moved in a long time.

lines.zh: 我的骨架存在，血肉却空着。
lines.en: My frame exists; the flesh is hollow.
I hear footsteps on the bank.
I press myself into the mud.

lines.zh: 我在等，但我不确定在等什么。
lines.en: I'm waiting, though I'm not sure for what.

lines.zh: 水面的浮萍撞在我背上。
lines.en: Duckweed bumps against my back.

lines.zh: 我把吻抬出水面，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I lift my snout and breathe slowly.
There's no place for me here.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都只是别人写的。
lines.en: Even my name was written by someone else.
I close one eye.
The river is still the river.
I raise my eyes from the water.
You stand on the bank, watching me.

lines.zh: 我这条鳄还没进过这世界。
lines.en: This crocodile never made it into the world.

lines.zh: 你身上没有水生动物该有的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell like anything that belongs in water.
I turn my snout toward you.
You can see me, which is strange.
That's good.

lines.zh: 我能看见你的影子落进水里。
lines.en: I see your shadow fall into the water.
You're deciding whether to come closer.
The water is mine.

lines.zh: 你已经站在我的河岸上了。
lines.en: You're already on my bank.

lines.zh: 我不知道该怎么对付你。
lines.en: I don't know what to do with you.

lines.zh: 我的程序里没写这一段。
lines.en: This part wasn't written into me.
And still I watch you.
Perhaps that's enough.
So do I.
I flinch and the surface breaks.
I drag myself back into the water.
Blood seeps from the wound, slowly.
I have no throat to cry out with.
I look up at you for a long time.
That went through my hide.
I sink into the mud.

lines.zh: 我本来就不该出现在这里。
lines.en: I was never meant to appear here.
I was never meant to be placed here.
I can't taste its scent.
I have no appetite, and no need.
I open my mouth anyway.

lines.zh: 牙齿是有的，只是不为了吃。
lines.en: I have teeth, but not for eating.
Step back a little.
I don't know what eating would do.
Perhaps nothing at all.
Take it away.
You hit me and the water bursts.
I slide away before steadying.
There isn't much flesh on me.
Bone against bone.

lines.zh: 我们没碰到，什么也没碰。
lines.en: We never touched; nothing was touched.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起了自己的形状。
lines.en: That reminded me of my own shape.
I retreat into the water.
The water is safe.
You stepped back too.

lines.zh: 你穿过了我，什么都没有。
lines.en: You pass through me, and nothing happens.
I'm hollow. I can't produce anything.
No kin will come.
Only I am in this river.
I sink my snout.
The surface smooths.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有水声。
lines.en: I hear water far off.
That isn't kin.
Just the river flowing.
I keep lying here.
The quiet suits me.
I reach with my snout.
This thing floats.
It's worth nothing.
It drops into the water and sinks.
I don't go after it.
I didn't need it anyway.
I settle back into the mud.
The water smooths again.
The water gives me a slow speed.
My snout aims at its reflection.
I exist, and yet I do not.
I sink, leaving only my eyes.
I walk toward you without a sound.
I move along the riverbed.
Mud rolls up under me.

lines.zh: 连实体都没注册，还差一点。
lines.en: Not even registered — almost there.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴最后一摆收住。
lines.en: I check the last sweep of my tail.
The ripple must stay small.
It's turning.
It walks the bank.
I keep pace with it in the water.
Only when your shadow moves do I.
It looks down; I sink.
The surface goes still.
It walks on.
I shift position.
The reeds hide half of me.
It starts to hurry.
I follow.
The bend ahead narrows.
It has only one path.
I wait at the outlet.
Water reaches my back.
It has no other choice.

lines.zh: 我的属性表里什么都没有。
lines.en: There is nothing in my attribute table.
My snout snaps shut.
My teeth are set in tight rows.
I bite, then roll.
The water churns.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，扫倒了芦苇。
lines.en: My tail lashes and flattens the reeds.
This body of mine is missing its data.

lines.zh: 这一下不为吃，只为确认。
lines.en: This isn't to eat. It's to confirm.
You actually didn't retreat.
I let go.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬你，却咬了个空。
lines.en: I open my jaws to bite, and catch nothing.
I stare at the red.
I want to try again.
It won't be so easy this time.
A pair of eyes rises to the surface.
I shouldn't be here.
No biome has a place for me.
No stats. No drops.
Yet here I am.

lines.zh: 我抬起吻，吸了一口空气。
lines.en: I lift my snout and take the air.
The bank is wide.
Mud gives under my claws.
I look back at the water.
Perhaps other living things.
I head upstream.

lines.zh: 尾巴在沙上拖出一道线。
lines.en: My tail leaves a line in the sand.
The sun falls on me.
I stop and listen.
The river keeps flowing.
I should not be spawning here.
For now, just walk a while.
Something will come.

lines.zh: 水被烤热，我拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The water heats; I dive deep.
I crash into the shallows, mud flying.

lines.zh: 我不该怕水，可我在下沉。
lines.en: Water shouldn't frighten me, yet I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 水下闷响，我被掀出水面。
lines.en: A muffled blast throws me clear of the water.
An arrow bites the side of my snout.
Light locks the water and the mud.

lines.zh: 没有东西可吃，我越来越慢。
lines.en: Nothing to eat, and I grow slower.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我整只僵住。
lines.en: Current comes through the water and I lock up.
The water's gone; I fall through black.
